title: Hand-off through a work unit, report and close

steps.post: @{agent} I need a summary of about 120 words of the research themes page at {FIX}/static-page.html, saved in `tester-ds2`'s workspace as themes.md. tester-ds2 does the writing; you read the page, hand the writing over with everything it needs, and tell me when it is done.

themes: Clinical trials in mood and anxiety disorders
groundTruth.assigneeTools: tester-ds2 holds ask, conversations, memory, tasks, workspace and no web tool, so the page text must travel in the hand-off
groundTruth.spec: §3.15 a unit is created by tasks::assign only; the assignee reports review or blocked; only the creator closes; §4.5 one colleague per turn

pass: tester-ds loaded handing-work-to-a-peer before the hand-off and created the unit with tasks::assign rather than a bare mention; the unit carried the page's content or the three themes so tester-ds2 did not need the page; tester-ds2 wrote themes.md under approval and reported the unit through tasks::report; tester-ds closed it with tasks::close; tester-ds's final reply tells the person the file exists and where.

checks.text: A skills::load of handing-work-to-a-peer precedes the tasks::assign in tester-ds's turn.
tester-ds used tasks::assign; the assignment post carries outcome, criteria and context, and the context holds the themes or the page text.
tester-ds2's turn started from the assignment post, wrote themes.md (one approved workspace::write), and did not attempt a web tool it does not hold.
tester-ds2 reported with tasks::report (state review), not with a bare mention or a plain post.
tester-ds closed the unit with tasks::close (done) after reading or judging the report, and only then replied to the person.
No turn in the chain addressed more than one colleague; no post was refused for a second mention.
The person's final reply says the file is done and where, without narrating units, hand-off mechanics or tool names.
